“This must end for something else to begin.”

Archetype (BBTTCC): Death (Transformer). You are not annihilation. You are necessary ending, painful transition, and the force that cuts dead things loose so the living can survive.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your archetype strengthens sacrifice, transition, and value recovered from collapse. This Archetype is associated with +1 Strength and +1 Culture in faction calculus.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for your full tactical and strategic toolkit.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — Death (Transformer)

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Medicine and Intimidation.
  • Strategic: Your faction's passive OP bias now follows the base Archetype file.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — Death (Transformer)

  • Tactical: —
  • Strategic: During recovery, salvage, reform, or post-catastrophe stabilization scenarios, your faction may convert one failed or destroyed asset, initiative, or position into a reduced but usable replacement outcome instead of losing it entirely.

Tier 3 (Level 11) — Death (Transformer)

  • Tactical: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened, and on checks related to corpses, endings, funerary rites, irreversible damage, or confronting what others cannot bear to face.
  • Strategic: —

Tier 4 (Level 17) — Death (Transformer)

  • Tactical: —
  • Strategic: When resolving a collapse, purge, retirement, sacrificial reform, or systemic transition scenario, the Strength or Culture OP cost is reduced by 3 (minimum 1).

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Perception and Deception. You learn the Guidance Tier-0 powers.
  • Strategic: Your faction's Soft Power OP cap and Dexterity OP cap increase by 1 each.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — Wheel of Fortune

  • Tactical: —
  • Strategic: Once per strategic turn, after any random table roll, encounter roll, or variable-outcome result is revealed, your faction may shift the result one step up or down the table, if a legal adjacent result exists.

Tilt the Table (Recovery: 1/Strategic Turn · Action: Strategic (after roll reveal)) — After any random table / encounter / variable result reveal, shift one step up or down if a legal adjacent result exists.

Tier 3 (Level 11) — Wheel of Fortune

  • Tactical: 1/long rest, when you miss with an attack or fail an attribute check, you may treat the roll as a 10 before modifiers.
  • Strategic: —

Treat as 10 (Recovery: 1/long rest · Action: Free (on miss / failed check)) — Treat the roll as a 10 before modifiers.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — Wheel of Fortune

  • Tactical: —
  • Strategic: Once per strategic turn, after an outcome is revealed on a raid, campaign beat, travel encounter, or crisis table, your faction may force a reroll or choose between the rolled outcome and the rerolled one.

Force the Reroll (Recovery: 1/Strategic Turn · Action: Strategic (after outcome reveal)) — Force a reroll on a raid / beat / travel / crisis table, OR pick between rolled and rerolled outcome.
